chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Amir ibn Ma'qil, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him). He said: He said to me:

O Abu Hamza, do not place Ali lower than where Allah has placed him, and do not raise Ali higher than where Allah has raised him. It is sufficient for Ali that he fights the people of the Return and that he weds the people of Paradise.

key_terms.الكرة: al-Karra (the Return/Raj'a) - Shia eschatological concept of the return of certain figures before the Day of Judgment
key_terms.يزوج: to wed/unite in marriage - Ali's role in Paradise

ai.seo_question: What is the station of Imam Ali according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) instructed Abu Hamza al-Thumali on the correct approach to the station of Imam Ali (AS), warning against both diminishing and exaggerating his rank. He highlighted two unique eschatological roles: leading battle during the Raj'a (the Return before Judgment Day) and uniting Paradise's inhabitants in marriage.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from `Ali b. al-Hakam from `Amer b. Mu`aqqal from Abi Hamza al-Thumali from Abi Ja`far (as). He said: He said to me:

O Aba Hamza! Do not place `Ali lower than where Allah has placed him, and do not raise `Ali higher than where Allah has placed him. It is enough that `Ali fights the people of the globe and that he brings the people of Paradise together.
